scope: F# core model, all five decision variants and published parameter tables. No experiment suite, EM fitting or references.
source_review: Implementation reviewed against full paper; parameter Tables II–IV visually checked. Not independently audited.
choices: Use printed tau log-sum-exp equation over preceding sum-of-utilities prose.
Social-proof percentage interpreted as fraction; absent recent tweets imply zero trend.
Sixty previous minutes, next-step delivery and four subsequent cooldown minutes.
Historical input seeds consistency and prior cooldown; empty history is an illustrative cold start.
NoTweet has no topic/external factors; only nested models add profile factors.
validation: Checks.fsx passes utility, single/nested probabilities, profile and influence factors, delayed delivery, cooldown, historical windows and five variants.
Example completes 120 minutes and emits 26 tweets with seed 1.
